name: sort
label: Sort
help: Latest returns the newest alerts first. Relevance uses Sales Navigator's own order.

name: category
label: Category
help: Return only lead alerts or only account alerts. Leave empty for both.

name: types
label: Alert Types
help: Return only these alert types, for example LEAD_SHARED_UPDATE, LEAD_ACCEPTED_INVITATION, LEAD_PROFILE_VIEW_SIGNAL, ACCOUNT_SHARED_UPDATE or ACCOUNT_SENIOR_HIRE. All known types: https://linkedapi.io/docs/action-nv-retrieve-alerts#alert-types. Leave empty for all types.

name: since
label: Since
help: Return only alerts published at or after this date and time.

name: excludeSuggested
label: Exclude Suggested
help: Return only alerts about leads and accounts you have saved, leaving out suggested ones.

name: listId
label: List ID
help: Return only alerts about members of this list. Find it in the Retrieve Lists output or at the end of the list's URL. Works only with Latest sorting.

name: subjects
label: Leads and Accounts
help: Return only alerts about these leads or accounts. Enter Sales Navigator lead or account URLs (/sales/lead/... or /sales/company/...) or Subject URN values from earlier alerts.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Maximum number of alerts to return, up to 1000. Leave empty to return up to 50.
